label: Gmail
blurb: Read your Gmail inbox. Sign in with Google.
unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: Any mailbox
blurb: Read any mailbox with its login: Outlook, your own domain, others.

fields.label: IMAP server
fields.help: In your mail settings, under IMAP. For Gmail it is imap.gmail.com.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: For Gmail or Outlook, an app password from your account's security settings.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.help: Kept for sending later. Nothing is sent today.

unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

blurb: Read your WhatsApp chats. Scan a code with your phone, or type a pairing code.
unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: Telegram
blurb: Read your Telegram chats. Scan a code with your phone, or log in with your number.
unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: LinkedIn
blurb: Read your LinkedIn messages. Log in with your email and password.
unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: GoHighLevel
blurb: Read your contacts, kept up to date on their own.

fields.label: Private Integration Token
fields.help: In GoHighLevel: Settings, then Private Integrations. Create one and copy the token.

fields.label: Sub-account ID
fields.help: In GoHighLevel: Settings, then Business Profile. It is the Location ID.

unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: PostHog
blurb: See who visited your site, by name, once they are identified.

fields.label: Personal API key
fields.help: In PostHog: Settings, then Personal API keys. Create one with the Query read scope.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: eu.posthog.com is EU, app.posthog.com is US.

unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: Stripe
blurb: See what each customer paid you.

fields.label: Restricted key
fields.help: In Stripe: Developers, then API keys. Create a restricted key with Read on Customers and Charges.

unavailableReason: The demo shows example data. Connect your own accounts on your own GTM Factory.

label: Clerk
blurb: See everyone who signed up to your product.

fields.label: Secret key
fields.help: In Clerk: Configure, then API keys. Copy the Secret key of your production instance.
